capabilities: Insert a timestamp when a checkbox is checked
Record start and end times via Doing status
Format timestamps with dates and daily-note links
Enable tracking per page with the cssclasses property
extras: The plugin does not style the Doing status (- [/]); the README points to a separate CSS snippet to install. Can also be installed via the BRAT beta plugin installer.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record when a task checkbox was completed, so completion times must be typed manually.
summary: Plugin that inserts a timestamp into a task line when its checkbox is checked, optionally recording start and end times.
